items.title: Winard Harper interviewed by Monk Rowe, Utica, New York, October 10, 2014
items.q: him and Higgins both had a big influence on me as well as Elvin and a bunch of other guys

ctx.x: That’s amazing that a person could have that kind of force without bashing.

Right. Because I mean, like I said, it’s that inside, that intent, where you know how to give what you need, and so much spiritual energy is coming out through you, that you are able to bring up and call forth. But I mean if anybody knew Cannonball you’d hear some of the same stories about Cannonball. People tell me man, Cannon’s personality, even when he wasn’t playing, if he walked in the room it was just something about him, you just knew Cannon was there. Well that’s the same way with his sound. So a lot of…
Okay, let me try another one here.
